items.text: Fixed old scientists movement and AI getting stuck, including crouch‑walk angle on stairs and slower behavior.
Improved navmesh sampling to eliminate spikes from unreachable points.
Deployables placed inside rooms now work via separate network groups.

Tuned conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue pacing.

items.text: Fixed AI agents getting stuck on navmesh edges, corners, or when a navmesh tile is rebuilt, and prevented unnecessary path reprojection.
Resolved a crash caused by a collection‑modified exception when the navigation system was paused.
Fixed a tiger AI bug where it would charge indefinitely at the base of vine trees.
Added debug commands to select, move, and release NPCs, letting players direct individual AI with selectable movement types (sneak, walk, jog, run, sprint, full sprint).
Construction resources, medical, and food crates now break apart into visible pieces when emptied instead of vanishing, using a shared wooden crate gib model.
Tier‑2 lootbox now retains its unique material on broken pieces, fixing missing tier markings.
Enabled read/write access for primitive lootbox gib data to support crate breaking behavior.
Fixed a server error caused by vehicle pooling that could crash Modular Cars during decay damage.
Boat fuel, start engine, and stop engine options are now shown only to the driver, matching other vehicle UI behavior.
Fixed chainlink fence issues across several monuments.
Corrected oil monument behavior after a stomp event.
Fixed missing inspector arguments, added tile prefabs, introduced a character preview, and added a toggle on the character creator page.
Implemented a fixed‑size grid system for flex UI grids, removing the need to compute gaps and column counts manually.
Fixed world‑model sorting for AR glass objects so they render correctly with other glass items.
Adjusted glass icon rendering and rotation tweaks for proper visual alignment.
Fixed boat fuel interaction bug.
Refreshed flashlight weapon: new animator, subsystem setup, correct prop rotation, updated viewmodel and animation events for sounds.
Updated glass AK ammo script to hide bullet models when ammo is depleted.
Fixed character creator page setup issue.
Added level placement socket to animal fences and gates.
Fixed mesh issues for monument blockers.
Changed monument avoidance logic to use the PreventBuildingMonumentTag static registry.
Updated military tunnel, oilrig, and launch site monument placements.
Console commands let you select, move, and release NPCs, supporting both legacy and FSM AI.

### NPC & AI
